summary: Linked-list name lookup. Reads the global head pointer dword_8B8E20 and, if it is non-null, walks the list node by node via a next-pointer stored at node+2160, comparing each node's name string at node+20 against the input string a1 (strcmp). Returns the first matching node pointer, or 0 when the list is empty, the name is absent, or the chain ends. Called by ten renderer/font callers including FontSurfaceLookupDispatch (0053D260) and SurfaceSizeQuery (004DC600).

local_names.v1: cursor pointer over the linked list nodes
local_names.a1: requested name string to match against node names

operations.description: Load the global list head pointer dword_8B8E20 into the cursor v1.
When the head pointer dword_8B8E20 is null the list is empty; take the empty-list return path.
Iterate over linked-list nodes while the current node name does not match a1.
String-compare the current node's name at v1+20 against the input string a1 (strcmp).
On mismatch, advance to the next node through the link pointer stored at v1+2160.
If the next node pointer is null the requested name is absent; take the not-found return path.
Return the pointer to the matching node (v1), or 0 when traversal ends without a match.

Invoked by ten renderer/font callers (SurfaceSizeQuery, ScaledTextureRender, FrameRateCounterInitReset, ConditionalInitBranch, FontSurfaceLookupDispatch, GuardedDelegation, sub_53D2E0, ConditionalFontSurfaceCall, sub_4989E0, sub_49F870).
